summary: Verified NEW round items: (1) sound toggle in tray (mute/unmute, icon swap, localStorage persistence across reload), (2) Settings > SYSTEM SOUNDS On/Off cards synced with tray via himeshos-sound-change event, (3) world2-exit fires logout screen with no console errors, (4) real Rocky GLB model loads from /models/rocky.glb (HTTP 200, 396KB) and renders as stone statue hovering beside the 3D computer monitor in the Space Act — procedural ball-with-eyes fallback is NOT visible, (5) backend /api/health returns {status:ok, rocky_llm:true} and POST /api/rocky returns reply, (6) mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow across World 1 sections and rocky-chat-trigger is present. Zero console/page errors throughout.
critical_code_review_comments: World2.tsx is 533 lines and mixes desktop chrome, taskbar, tray, context menu, start menu, and logout screen — consider splitting Taskbar/StartMenu/Tray into separate files to keep files <400 lines.

Desktop() uses window.innerWidth once at mount (`const mobile = window.innerWidth < 768`) without a resize listener; rotating a tablet/resizing won't recompute mobile mode. Non-blocking but worth noting.
test_credentials: None (no auth beyond guest press-Enter login screen).
